root_cause.text: The error unwinding path in `mana_ib_create_qp_rss()` incorrectly decrements the loop index `i` twice when `mana_create_wq_obj()` fails, and fails to clean up the successfully created WQ object at index `i` if `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` fails.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the manual `i--` decrement on `mana_create_wq_obj()` failure and adds an explicit call to `mana_destroy_wq_obj()` to clean up the WQ object at index `i` when `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` fails before jumping to the `fail` label.

The group's core intent directly addresses one of the key elements of the vulnerability root cause, which is the failure to clean up the successfully created WQ object when mana_ib_install_cq_cb() fails.

candidates.rationale: This statement decrements the loop index `i` when `mana_create_wq_obj()` fails, which leads to a double decrement of `i` during the error unwinding path.
When `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` fails, jumping to `fail` directly without cleaning up the successfully created WQ object at index `i` causes a resource leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement decrements the loop index 'i' when mana_create_wq_obj() fails. Because the error unwinding path at the 'fail' label also decrements 'i', this causes a double decrement of the loop index, resulting in a failure to clean up some of the successfully created WQ objects.

When mana_ib_install_cq_cb() fails, jumping directly to 'fail' without cleaning up the WQ object successfully created at the current index 'i' causes a resource leak, as the unwinding path only cleans up objects up to index 'i-1'.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the buggy 'i--' decrement on line 214 when 'mana_create_wq_obj()' fails. Because the error cleanup path at the 'fail' label uses 'while (i-- > 0)' (line 281) which already decrements 'i' before accessing the array, decrementing 'i' beforehand causes the cleanup loop to skip the last successfully allocated WQ object (at index 'i - 1'), leading to a resource leak.
